title: Chapter 5 Lu Xue'S Physique And Bloodline
content:
Chapter 5 Lu Xue'S Physique And Bloodline

When he saw the old man, Lu Daosheng frowned.

He disliked this old man very much.

"Xiaoxue, come here."

Lu Daosheng tried his best to keep smiling and waved to Lu Xue.

Then Lu Xue came over obediently, and kept glancing at Gu Chen beside her.

Could it be that this is the master that Daddy found for him?

Suddenly, Lu Xue shook her head in her heart.

What kind of person could Daddy find for him in such a short time?

Then Lu Xue didn't have much confidence in Gu Chen.

On the side, Gu Chen was also looking at Lu Xue.

Is this Lu Daosheng's daughter?

She looks ordinary except for her beautiful appearance, but with his strength, he naturally saw that Lu Xue was not simple.

Lu Xue has a special physique, and her bloodline seems to be not simple.

But what exactly is it, we have to take a closer look.

At the same time, the old man Yu Qing in front of the three people was also looking at Lu Daosheng and Gu Chen.

Although he didn't see anything, Yu Qing still didn't take the two people seriously. One was the city lord of this broken city, and the other was the master found by the city lord of this broken city. How powerful could they be.

At this time, Lu Daosheng spoke.

"Come, Xiaoxue, this is Senior Gu Chen. From the next period of time, I will teach you to practice. Come on, call me master."

Hearing this, Lu Xue hesitated.

Seeing this scene, Lu Daosheng was embarrassed.

Gu Chen on the side was even more livid.

Since he became an emperor, I don't know how many people have been scrambling to worship him as a master, but now, a little girl who has just entered the Qi Refining Stage is actually hesitating.

Times have really changed.

At this time, Yu Qing in front of the three people sneered and said, "You are Lu Xue's father, right? This little girl has a special physique and a rare Xuanbing body. She can practice ice-based skills and martial arts with half the effort. She is also a good genius, and not just anyone can teach her."

Obviously, this sentence is about Gu Chen.

Hearing this, Gu Chen turned his head and looked at Lu Daosheng.

Then, Lu Daosheng understood.

"Come on, Xiaoxue, these two have something to say, let's avoid it first."

Hearing this, Lu Xue was stunned.

But before she opened her mouth, Lu Daosheng took her away.

On the spot, after watching Lu Daosheng and his daughter leave, Gu Chen looked at Yu Qing in front of him and his eyes suddenly became extremely cold.

He has lived for endless years, how could he not see the thoughts of this guy in front of him.

Suddenly, a terrifying pressure directly crushed Yu Qing in front of him.

"You!"

At the last moment, Yu Qing's eyes were filled with endless fear.

A moment later, in the room of Lu Daosheng in the City Lord's Mansion.

Gu Chen pushed the door open and entered.

"Is it solved?"

Seeing Gu Chen, Lu Daosheng smiled.

Gu Chen nodded, without saying anything more, but looked at Lu Xue.

This time, Lu Xue did not hesitate and went straight forward to pay respect to her master.

"Disciple Lu Xue, meet the master."

She may be a little dull, but she is not stupid. She has understood the gap between the person in front of her and Yu Qing. At least he is better than Yu Qing, and she doesn't like Yu Qing very much.

And now there is a better choice, and it was found by her father, so what is she hesitating about.

"Get up, I will guide you to practice in the next period of time."

Gu Chen looked at Lu Xue in front of him and nodded.

On the side, Lu Daosheng saw all this with a look of relief in his eyes.

At the same time, Lu Daosheng also began to explore Lu Xue's physique and bloodline.

Buzz——

On Lu Daosheng's forehead, a hazy eye suddenly appeared.

Suddenly, a mysterious gaze looked directly at Lu Xue.

Eye of Destiny!

The great magical power of the Destiny Realm.

When practiced to the extreme, it can even directly see through the fate of living beings.

Feeling that gaze, Lu Xue and Gu Chen suddenly felt that there was no secret.

Gu Chen was fine, but Lu Xue's face was slightly red.

After a moment, Lu Daosheng retracted his gaze.

"Dad, what were you doing just now?"

Lu Xue's face was slightly red.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng smiled and said, "Nothing, just some small tricks, Dad cares about your body."

Hearing this, Lu Xue just nodded and said nothing.

"Okay, you go down first. I have something to say to your master Gu Chen."

"Yes, then my daughter will leave first.

Goodbye, father, goodbye, master."

After Lu Xue left, Gu Chen stepped forward and said, "City Lord, have you seen her physique and bloodline?"

For Lu Daosheng, Gu Chen called him the City Lord.

And Lu Xue's physique is definitely not as simple as the Xuanbing body that Yu Qing said.

In Yu Qing's eyes, the Xuanbing body may be very powerful, but in the eyes of a strong man like him, the Xuanbing body has no sense of existence at all.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng was silent.

He saw that Lu Xue's physique and bloodline were extraordinary, but he couldn't name what they were.

Although he had strength, his knowledge was still too scarce.

He should read more books when he had time in the future.

However, although he didn't know, he had an omnipotent system.

"System."

[In]

"Help me check my daughter's physical constitution and bloodline."

[Yes, analyzing]

[...]

[Analysis completed]

[Name: Lu Xue]

[Constitution: Extreme Ice Spirit Body (the king of ice constitutions, extremely rare, extremely difficult to awaken, requires a lot of ice energy and innate ice magic weapons to awaken. Because of its extremely high difficulty in awakening, there has only been one famous strong man in the ages, who once froze an entire galaxy with a wave of his hand)]

[Bloodline: Nine Heavens Ice Phoenix Bloodline (legend has it that it comes from a branch of the Phoenix Clan above the Nine Heavens, the bloodline of the Ice Phoenix Clan)]

Seeing the system's analysis, Lu Daosheng was stunned.

This constitution is not bad, it's very good, the Extreme Ice Spirit Body, it sounds very good.

But what about this bloodline.

The bloodline of the Ice Phoenix Clan?

Where did his daughter get the Ice Phoenix bloodline? He still understood that bloodline is inherited, but who did his daughter inherit from, her mother?

That's not right. Lu Daosheng clearly remembered that Lu Xue's mother was a human, how could she be a Phoenix Clan.

It's even more impossible to be an Ice Phoenix Clan.

It seems that I have to investigate it carefully in the future.

At this time, seeing Lu Daosheng silent, Gu Chen thought that the other party did not see it either, and immediately shook his head.

At this time, Lu Daosheng finally spoke.

"Extreme Ice Spirit Body, Nine Heavens Ice Phoenix Bloodline."

Hearing this, Gu Chen looked shocked. Although he had never heard of it, it sounded very impressive.

"Okay, next, Xiaoxue's physique and blood awakening will be handed over to me. You just need to teach her well."

Gu Chen nodded, but then, Gu Chen hesitated and said, "Others don't seem to know your strength, including your daughter."

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng smiled and said, "I am usually low-key."

"Ah Wei."

The next moment, A Wei pushed the door open.

Lu Daosheng smiled and said, "Arrange a place for Brother Gu Chen to live."

"Yes, City Lord."

Then, Gu Chen didn't say anything else and left directly with A Wei.

On the spot, Lu Daosheng sighed.

His wife looked quite mysterious, but he didn't care. They were truly in love, and that was enough.

He would never forget that happy time.

But after so many years, she left them father and daughter to depend on each other, and Lu Daosheng still felt a little resentful.

Shaking his head, Lu Daosheng stopped thinking about women and began to prepare things to awaken his daughter's physical constitution and bloodline.

Now, his daughter was everything to him.

As for these things, they were naturally found in the system store.

Open the system store.

Suddenly, a dazzling array of goods appeared directly in front of Lu Daosheng.

"Tsk tsk tsk, so many good things, where did you get them, system?"

Lu Daosheng asked a little to himself, and then began to pick them up.

A huge piece of innate ice jade, hundreds of bottles of good fortune, and the essence of ice.

This was not over yet. The next moment, Lu Daosheng flew into the void and waved his hand directly.

Suddenly, the endless Law of Ice that filled the world began to condense in Lu Daosheng's hands. Such a heaven-defying move can be said to be unprecedented.

In less than a moment, Lu Daosheng had a necklace that materialized the Law of Ice in his hand.

Finally, Lu Daosheng embellished the essence of ice on the necklace, and after a slight improvement, it became a fine work of art.

After looking at it for a moment, Lu Daosheng smiled with satisfaction.

"Xiaoxue should like it."

At the same time, due to the large loss of the Law of Ice, the glaciers in Xuantian World began to melt and the sea level rose. The culprit of all this was actually trying to please his daughter at home!

Realm: Qi Refining, Innate, Spiritual Master, Breaking the Air, Concentrating the Soul, Divine Mansion, Fate Combination, Sage, Saint King, Quasi-Emperor, Great Emperor, Heavenly Emperor, Dao Realm, Ancient Realm, Unknown Realm
